import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { Watchlist } from '../app/watchlist/watchlist';
import { WatchlistStore } from '../app/watchlist-store';

@Component({ template: '' })
class BlankComponent {}

function seed(store: WatchlistStore, items: { id: number; title: string; watched: boolean }[]) {
  for (const it of items) {
    store.add({ id: it.id, title: it.title, release_date: '2024-01-01', poster_path: null, overview: 'A movie.' });
    if (it.watched) {
      store.toggleWatched(it.id);
    }
  }
}

function clearWatchedButton(el: HTMLElement): HTMLButtonElement | null {
  const buttons = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button'));
  return (
    buttons.find((b) => (b.textContent ?? '').toLowerCase().includes('clear watched')) ??
    null
  );
}

function render() {
  const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(Watchlist);
  TestBed.tick();
  return fixture;
}

  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [Watchlist],
      providers: [provideRouter([{ path: '**', component: BlankComponent }])],
    });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    TestBed.resetTestingModule();
  });

  it('is rendered when at least one movie is watched', () => {
    const store = TestBed.inject(WatchlistStore);
    seed(store, [
      { id: 1, title: 'Alpha', watched: false },
      { id: 2, title: 'Beta', watched: true },
    ]);
    const fixture = render();
    expect(clearWatchedButton(fixture.nativeElement)).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('removes only the watched movies when clicked', () => {
    const store = TestBed.inject(WatchlistStore);
    seed(store, [
      { id: 1, title: 'Alpha', watched: true },
      { id: 2, title: 'Beta', watched: false },
      { id: 3, title: 'Gamma', watched: true },
    ]);
    const fixture = render();
    const button = clearWatchedButton(fixture.nativeElement);
    expect(button).not.toBeNull();
    button!.click();
    TestBed.tick();
    expect(store.items().map((m) => m.id)).toEqual([2]);
    expect(store.watchedCount()).toBe(0);
    expect(store.count()).toBe(1);
  });

  it('is no longer rendered once no watched movies remain', () => {
    const store = TestBed.inject(WatchlistStore);
    seed(store, [
      { id: 1, title: 'Alpha', watched: true },
      { id: 2, title: 'Beta', watched: false },
    ]);
    const fixture = render();
    clearWatchedButton(fixture.nativeElement)!.click();
    TestBed.tick();
    expect(clearWatchedButton(fixture.nativeElement)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('is not rendered when nothing is watched', () => {
    const store = TestBed.inject(WatchlistStore);
    seed(store, [
      { id: 1, title: 'Alpha', watched: false },
      { id: 2, title: 'Beta', watched: false },
    ]);
    const fixture = render();
    expect(clearWatchedButton(fixture.nativeElement)).toBeNull();
  });
});
